title: Affine depth two boundary property
statement: theorem affine_depth_two_boundary_property (A : CommRingCat.{u}) [IsNoetherianRing A] (W : (Spec A).Opens) (hboundary : ∀ x : Spec A, x ∉ W → (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := (Spec A).presheaf.stalk x) ((Spec A).presheaf.stalk x)) (H : (Spec A).Modules) (hqc : H.IsQuasicoherent) (hfin : ∀ V : (Spec A).Opens, IsAffineOpen V → Module.Finite ((Spec A).presheaf.obj (op V)) (H.val.obj (op V))) : ∀ x : Spec A, x ∉ W → ∃ hfinite : Module.Finite ((Spec A).presheaf.stalk x) (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u}) H.val.presheaf x), letI := hfinite; (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := (Spec A).presheaf.stalk x) (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u}) H.val.presheaf x)

proof.text: Use a finite free presentation of the double dual kernel and regular-pair injectivity; Nakayama gives depth two.

lean.statement:
theorem affine_depth_two_boundary_property
    (A : CommRingCat.{u}) [IsNoetherianRing A] (W : (Spec A).Opens)
    (hboundary : ∀ x : Spec A, x ∉ W →
      (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth
        (R := (Spec A).presheaf.stalk x) ((Spec A).presheaf.stalk x))
    (H : (Spec A).Modules) (hqc : H.IsQuasicoherent)
    (hfin : ∀ V : (Spec A).Opens, IsAffineOpen V →
      Module.Finite ((Spec A).presheaf.obj (op V)) (H.val.obj (op V))) :
    ∀ x : Spec A, x ∉ W →
      ∃ hfinite : Module.Finite ((Spec A).presheaf.stalk x)
          (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u}) H.val.presheaf x),
        letI := hfinite
        (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := (Spec A).presheaf.stalk x)
          (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u}) H.val.presheaf x)
